focus: The Tamsa Release Protocol for the Tamsa Reservoir
knowledge_notes: Fictional background for the AI-agent engine: the Tamsa Reservoir supplies both a hydropower plant and the Lower Gerar irrigation canals. Planting week is the moment farmers need water most. All names in this case are invented.

scenarios.name: Protocol adopted with monitoring
scenarios.text: Hypothetical: the Gerar Basin Authority adopts the Tamsa Release Protocol with an earlier phase-in, and the Tamsa Monitoring System begins publishing weekly readings.

scenarios.name: Dry-season shortfall
scenarios.text: Hypothetical: late rains leave the Tamsa Reservoir below its safe level, canal releases are cut during planting week and power output falls on the same days.

scenarios.name: Compensation fund offered
scenarios.text: Hypothetical: the Tamsa Hydropower Company and the Highland Development Bank propose a compensation fund for lost output if the Tamsa Release Protocol is adopted.

scenarios.name: Misleading leak online
scenarios.text: Hypothetical: a misleading post claims the protocol will redirect reservoir water to export farms; the Highlands Independent Press and the Gerar Water Institute show the claim is false the next day.
